_comment: OAuth providers for mail accounts (oauth-core.js, Docs/EMAIL-MODERNIZATION-PLAN.md). brokerApp names the app at the broker, which holds that provider's client id and secret. device is the provider's own device-code flow, for a public client: its client id is public and there is no secret. Nothing secret is here. templateId is the account type the sign-in makes; mail is the account's server settings.

microsoft.title: Microsoft
microsoft._mail: IMAP and SMTP, for personal accounts (Outlook.com). The account type is hidden from Add Account: the Exchange sign-in below falls back to this one when Microsoft refuses Exchange's scope.

microsoft365.title: Microsoft Outlook
microsoft365._mail: Exchange ActiveSync, on Palm's mojomail-eas through libce-mailshim.so's adapters. Work and school accounts; Microsoft refuses this scope for a personal one (AADSTS70011), which then signs in with microsoft above.
